newsitem.title: UK: UK animal rights group calls for P&O boycott.
newsitem.headline: UK animal rights group calls for P&O boycott.

text.p: A UK animal rights group has called for a public boycott of ferry giant P&O Steam Navigation Co in protest against its policy to carry live animals to the Continent to be slaughtered.
Pressure group, Compassion in World Farming, said P&O decided to reverse its previous policy of banning the transportation of live animals being exported for slaughter.
The CWF slammed the U-turn saying animals were destined for cruel culling procedures overseas and suffered distress from the sea jounrney itself, citing pigs in particular.
"Pigs travel badly, being prone to dehydration and vomiting," said the statement.
The welfare group said it would continue to call for a boycott until P&O "ends all involvement with the cruel live export trade."
P&O, still recovering from a separate French fishermen's blockade of French ports, which ended earlier on Thursday, was not immediately available for comment.
